about: Who every LinkedIn post names and links, at Dinis's word (23 Nov 2026): "always tag me @diniscruz and https://www.linkedin.com/company/riskmandate/". A real LinkedIn tag needs the entity's URN (urn:li:person:... or urn:li:organization:...); until "urn" is filled in, the post names and links them in plain text.
